# gyro_container_service (Resource)

A service in a Gyro Containers (ECS) environment (Istanbul, tr-ist-1): a Docker image running on the node pool dedicated to you. Every change except `replicas` creates a new revision that rolls out without downtime. Secret values are stored encrypted and never read back (Terraform keeps what you configured). Domains activate once their DNS points to the service `host` (CNAME).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A web service in your Gyro Containers (ECS) environment (Istanbul).
# service_id is the id of the container environment you ordered (see gyro_services).
variable "db_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "gyro_container_service" "web" {
  service_id  = 123
  name        = "web"
  image       = "ghcr.io/acme/web:1.4"
  port        = 8080
  replicas    = 2
  cpu_m       = 500
  memory_mi   = 512
  public      = true
  health_path = "/healthz"

  env     = { MODE = "prod" }
  secrets = { DB_PASSWORD = var.db_password } # write only, never read back

  # Point a CNAME from your domain to gyro_container_service.web.host first.
  domains = ["app.example.com"]
}

output "web_url" {
  value = gyro_container_service.web.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Image reference, e.g. ghcr.io/acme/web:1.4.
- `name` (String) Service name: lowercase letters, digits and '-', max 40.
- `service_id` (Number) Container environment (service) id.

### Optional

- `args` (List of String) Arguments for the command.
- `command` (List of String) Override the image entrypoint.
- `cpu_m` (Number) CPU per instance in millicores.
- `domains` (Set of String) Your domains (CNAME to `host`); requires public = true.
- `env` (Map of String) Plain environment variables.
- `health_path` (String) HTTP health check path (empty = TCP check).
- `memory_mi` (Number) Memory per instance in MiB.
- `port` (Number) Container port (0 = no network port). Use >= 1024 (non-root).
- `public` (Boolean) Public HTTPS address <name>-<code>.gyroapp.net.
- `replicas` (Number) Number of instances (0 = stopped).
- `run_as_user` (Number) User id in the container (0 = platform default 10001).
- `secrets` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret environment variables (write only; a key removed outside Terraform shows as a diff).

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) Public host name; CNAME target for your domains.
- `id` (String) <service_id>/<name>
- `revision` (Number) Current revision number.
- `state` (String) running, deploying, failing, pending, stopped or suspended (at the last read).
- `url` (String) Public URL (public services).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_container_service.web 123/web
```
